programme.title: Remembers...
programme.sub-title: Michael Palin Remembers... Michael Palin's Hemingway Adventure
programme.desc: Few people have followed in Ernest Hemingway's footsteps quite like Michael Palin. In this fascinating interview, the much-loved broadcaster, writer and traveller reflects on his journey through the landscapes, cultures and stories that shaped one of the 20th century's most celebrated authors. From Hemingway's homes and favourite haunts to the adventures that inspired his greatest works, Michael shares the highlights of his travels, revealing what he learned about the man behind the legend.

programme.title: Michael Palin's Hemingway Adventure
programme.desc: Michael Palin follows Ernest Hemingway's footsteps across Europe, Africa and America. He starts in Spain for Pamplona's bull run, Valencia's bullfighting and a Kenyan safari.

programme.title: Michael Palin's Hemingway Adventure
programme.desc: Michael Palin moves from the busy streets of Chicago to a suburb of Oak Park, Illinois. Here, in a town that Hemingway apparently called a place of `wide lawns and narrow minds', his ambitious and creative mother dressed him as a girl and wrote some melancholy music. Later, in Michigan, Michael visits the family summer cottage.

programme.title: Windrush: Portraits of a Generation
programme.desc: Marking the 75th anniversary of the arrival of HMT Empire Windrush by following a remarkable project spearheaded by King Charles III, who has commissioned ten leading artists to create portraits of ten pioneering members of the Windrush Generation.

programme.title: Stonehenge: The Lost Circle Revealed
programme.desc: Professor Alice Roberts follows a decade-long historical quest to reveal a hidden secret of the famous bluestones of Stonehenge. Using cutting-edge research, a dedicated team of archaeologists led by Prof Mike Parker Pearson have painstaking compiled evidence to fill in a 400-year gap in knowledge of the bluestones, and to show that the original stones of Britain's most iconic monument had a previous life.

programme.title: Art of America
programme.desc: In Levittown, Andrew Graham-Dixon uncovers the dark side of post-war consumerism and the role artists have played in challenging the status quo. He visits New York's Metropolitan Museum to see the most subversive artwork of 1950s America, Jasper Johns's White Flag, examines Andy Warhol's soup can paintings and interviews one of the last surviving pop artists, James Rosenquist.

programme.title: American Visions
programme.desc: Robert Hughes considers how the Civil War industrialised society, bringing steam power, the Brooklyn Bridge, plutocrats and an urban underclass. Nostalgia for loss entered the culture and brought the Museum Age.

programme.title: Vienna: Empire, Dynasty and Dream
programme.desc: Simon Sebag Montefiore tells the story of Vienna triumphant, after the Ottoman threat receded at the end of the 17th century. The city was rebuilt. No longer an outpost defending the West from Islamic invaders, the Habsburgs vowed their empire and imperial capital would become the most glittering in the world. The Habsburg emperors transformed the city from a fortress into a great cultural capital.

programme.title: Timeshift

programme.desc: A glorious national obsession is explored in this archive-rich look at the evolution of the weather forecast from print via radio to TV and beyond - and at the changing weather itself.

programme.title: The Summer of 76!
programme.desc: The most famous heatwave of the century was in 1976 and these are the red-hot hits that soundtracked that summer. Including 'Dancing Queen', 'Jeans On', 'Devil Woman' and 'Combine Harvester'.

programme.title: A History of Britain by Simon Schama
programme.desc: Simon Schama tackles the 20th century through the lives of two men, Winston Churchill and George Orwell. Both men, so very different in almost every way, lived through and wrote about the key moments of British 20th-century life: the Depression, Empire, two world wars and the Cold War. What unites them, argues Schama, is one shared theme - forget history at your peril.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni

programme.title: Tomos a'i Ffrindiau
programme.desc: Pan mae Sandi yn clywed am lwyth mawr o dywod sydd angen ei gludo, mae hi'n benderfynol o helpu, er gwaethaf ei maint. Sandy learns about a big shipment of sand that needs to be delivered.

programme.title: Dal Dy Ddannedd
programme.desc: Timau o Ysgol Y Castell sy'n ymuno â Pwdryn a Melys i chwarae llond trol o gemau lliwgar! Teams from Ysgol Y Castell join Pwdryn and Melys to play a series of candyland-themed games.

programme.title: Sam Tân
programme.desc: Mae Malcolm, Mike, Helen, Mandy a Norman wedi mynd i gerdded, ond mae tan yn dechrau yn y goedwig! Malcolm, Mike, Helen, Mandy and Norman go out walking, but a fire starts in the forest!

programme.title: Blwi
programme.desc: The family play a game where they trek around the Blue Mountains and outsmart the cheeky fox.

programme.title: Blero Yn Mynd I Ocido

programme.title: Kim a Cêt a Twrch
programme.desc: Ymunwch â Kim a Cêt ar antur hudolus a chwareus sy'n llawn dawns a cherddoriaeth wrth iddyn nhw chwilio am Twrch yn y goedwig. Kim and Cêt go on a magical and playful adventure in the forest.

programme.title: Sion Y Chef
programme.desc: Mae'n galan gaeaf a thra bod Izzy a Magi'n paratoi parti yn y bwyty, mae Siôn a Jac Jôs yn gwersylla mewn coedwig gyfagos. Siôn and Jac Jôs go camping in the woods to conquer their fears leaving Izzy to make the pumpkin soup for the Halloween party.

programme.title: Ne-wff-ion
programme.desc: Heddiw byddwn yn cwrdd ag archeolegydd sy'n cloddio mewn mynwent ger y Barri. An unusual hockey team in Cardiff is looking for new players of all ages, and we'll also hear your stories.

programme.title: Twm Twrch
programme.desc: Beth sy'n digwydd ym myd Twm Twrch a'i ffrindiau? What's happening in the world of Twm Twrch and friends?

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Diolch i dechnoleg estron, mae Joni'n dysgu bod angen mwy na doniau'n unig ar archarwr. Thanks to alien technology, Joni learns that a superhero needs more than just talent.

programme.title: Waw!

programme.title: Penblwyddi Cyw
programme.desc: Cyfle i edrych 'nôl dros rai o gyfarchion pen-blwydd yr wythnos. A look back at some of this week's birthday greetings.

programme.title: Y Fets
programme.desc: Yn ail rhaglen y gyfres newydd, mae 'na ddrama yn y sied wyna yng nghefn y practis. In episode two: drama with the lambs, and Ruby the bichon frisé and Floyd the spaniel need the vet's help.

programme.title: Gwesty Aduniad
programme.desc: Mae Gwesty Aduniad ar agor eto ac yn dod a Peter Jones a'i dad at ei gilydd am y tro cynta erioed. Political activist Meinir Ffransis reunites with a cell-mate and a gang of carers reunite.

programme.title: Garddio A Mwy
programme.desc: Mae Sioned yn derbyn cyngor yr arbenigwr planhigion Ian Keith Jones ar sut i greu cornel drofannol ei naws ym Mhont y Twr. Meinir has decided to plant a rather unusual plant: the pomato.

programme.title: Dechrau Canu Dechrau Canmol
programme.desc: Nia Roberts sy'n rhannu gwledd o ganu mawl a straeon ysbrydoledig wrth i ni fwynhau rhai o uchafbwyntiau'r gyfres. Series highlights, and we hear a stunning performance by Siwan Henderson.

programme.title: Y Sioe Fwyd
programme.desc: Yn ymuno ag Ifan Jones Evans a'r cogydd Hywel Griffith yn y rhaglen hon fydd y ddarlledwraig Beti George. Ifan Jones Evans and chef Hywel Griffith are joined by broadcaster and journalist, Beti George.

programme.title: Cynefin

programme.desc: Yn y bennod hon, edrychwn ar nifer o enghreifftiau o ymdrechion cadwraeth, gan gynnwys toeau gwyrdd yr Almaen. A look at city dwellers who save the planet by living with wildlife.
